answer: Simultaneous cross-examination tests each seat live on its own signed history. At a random instant the network questions 20% of seats at once about details only their past answers hold, such as the plume height in a smoke-dispersion audit, the low tide time in a harbour schedule, or the pH cited for a lotus pond survey, with a 10 s reply window. A wrong or late reply burns a 100 POA bond. One operator running 500 personas must keep 500 distinct histories loaded concurrently, and answering them one after another fails because every probe shares the same deadline.
